caseName: Housing Authority of Louisville v. Fletcher
caseNameFull: Housing Authority of Louisville v. Fletcher and Department of Housing and Urban Development v. Fletcher

opinions.text: C. A. 6th Cir. Motion of respondent in both cases for leave to proceed in forma pauperis granted. Certiorari granted, judgment vacated, and cases remanded for further consideration in light of § 201 of the Housing and Community Development Act of 1974, 88 Stat. 653, 42 U. S. C. §§ 1437-1437j (1970 ed., Supp. IV).
